AROMA_OF_CHAOS.pages.INITIAL.description:
After pushing your way through a dense thicket into a clearing, an inexplicable wave of nostalgia washes over you.
It is a blend of floral fragrance, putrid rot, and something beyond words. With every step forward, the scent grows thicker. At the same time, the world around you begins to warp and spin.
An ever-shifting chaos engulfs you, and you slowly begin to lose your sense of self.
You sheath your claws and let your consciousness drift along the blizzard toward your deepest obsession...
You see yourself shattering every high wall and dam in the world, leading tribes that have remembered how to roar in a blood-soaked hunt beneath thunderclouds—even that stubborn ram stands beside you atop the peak once more. Is this an omen of the wild reborn, or a lie woven by the scent? Deep within the mist, countless lidless eyes from beyond gaze coldly at you and your dream. Who... are they...?
After what feels like an eternity, a muffled thunderclap detonates inside your chest.
The scent scatters before the scalding white breath exhaled from your jaws. As rolling thunder courses through your veins once more, your mind feels sharper than ever before.
[sine][red]Those eyes peering from behind the mist... what were they?[/red][/sine]
SUNKEN_TREASURY.pages.INITIAL.descriptio:
A narrow path leads you to a partially flooded treasury.
You spot 2 chests inside, yet you only have 1 fragile key.
The first chest: When you shake it, you hear a faint jingle—likely a small amount of Gold.
The second chest: Massive, ornate, and unmistakably cursed. Packed with Gold!
SUNKEN_TREASURY.pages.FIRST_CHEST.descri: Sure enough, there is Gold inside.
SUNKEN_TREASURY.pages.SECOND_CHEST.descr:
A single swipe of your claw shatters the submerged great chest, sending piles of Gold clattering into the muddy water.
[sine]Cold, lifeless metal means nothing—yet if all the gold and iron in the world were locked beneath my claws...[/sine]
{Monologue}
[sine]Stripped of the wealth they hide behind, cowardly tribes would have no choice but to offer blood to the storm once more...[/sine]
A greed that even old gods are not immune to creeps up your spine along with the rising water...
